create_subclass_BaseModel: create a subclass of BaseModel that implements _init and _forward methods for a custom model
implement_init_BaseModel: implement the _init method in a BaseModel subclass to initialize model layers from config
implement_forward_BaseModel: implement the _forward method in a BaseModel subclass to return prediction tensors from input data
implement_loss_BaseModel: implement the loss method in a BaseModel subclass to compute and return a dictionary of loss values
configure_BaseModel: configure a BaseModel subclass with default_conf and required_data_keys for custom model behavior
